content.rendered:
Registration is now open for students starting Kindergarten in fall 2024! Incoming Kindergarten students must turn 5 on or before September 1, 2024.

For information on enrolling your kindergartener for the upcoming school year, including online registration and elementary school boundary information, please visit our district enrollment website at bit.ly/SSDenroll.
